text: I bought this coffee grinder used a few weeks ago, and overall it has been a decent little machine. The fine settings work surprisingly well, giving me a consistent grind for espresso and moka pot coffee. However, the coarse settings are uneven, so it is not great for French press or cold brew. The motor is also quite noisy, louder than I expected, especially early in the morning. On the plus side, the removable cup is very convenient and makes cleaning much easier than with my old grinder. For the price, I’m satisfied, but it definitely has a few flaws.
task: Write a fictional personal review of a used coffee grinder: uneven coarse settings, good fine settings, a noisy motor, and a removable cup that makes cleaning easier.
